main_text.l: In electione ipsorum speciale fuit, quod Christi
ipsis vili voce αμέσος & quasi ipsius χειροτονία
In ipsorum ordinatione speciale sunt,quod mo-
do à Christo immediatè designato in munus sint as-
ita vt in quaq; ministerij parte spiritus pleno afflatu
& motu sine errore & labe omni sint gubernati.
Duodecim,sunt illi qui à Christo adhuc in ter-
tiis versante designati sunt. Ibid. Mat. 28. Marc.

page.notes: Right margin note: "De Apo. specibus cap.18." (rendered as "De Apo. spe ecie bus cap.18."). Section marks and the diagram braces are approximated; the diagram lines are partly illegible. Several Greek words (αμέσος, χειροτονία) are transcribed as read and may be imprecise. The bottom "16.Act" and "Bb4" are signature and catchword elements rather than body text.
